name: Beatrice Bayo
source:
Her parents have decided to marry her off to a rich man to whom they owe a sizeable sum of money. In return for her hand, the man shall forgive her parents's debts. The ship will take her to her future husband.
She helps Louisa get on board, asking a favor in exchange...
